articles.title: Banks Build a Buffer
articles.content: JPMorgan Chase's provision for credit losses rose to $3.3 billion from $2.6 billion for the fourth quarter. Mac Sykes, portfolio manager of the GABF ETF at Gabelli Funds, said JPMorgan’s move during an otherwise solid quarter represented “a respect for the unknown economy going forward and prudent capital allocation.” JPMorgan’s consumer banking unit also reported that the 30-day delinquency rate for home lending increased to 1.04% from 0.78% for the fourth quarter.

articles.title: JPMorgan CEO Dimon expects recession and defaults, urges quick trade talks in Fox Business interview
articles.content: NEW YORK (Reuters) -JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon said on Wednesday that sweeping tariffs imposed by U.S. President Donald Trump will probably lead to a recession and defaults by borrowers, he told Fox Business’ Mornings with Maria program. Dimon urged fast progress on trade negotiations with U.S. trading partners in order to calm markets, which have been roiled by tariff announcements. I hope what they really do is ... get those things done quickly, he said, referring to trade negotiations between U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and other nations.
